create_checkpointer: create a checkpointer object for Jaxline experiments using a config dict and execution mode string
create_writer: create a TensorBoard logger writer for experiment data using a config dict and mode string
run_main_train: run the main Jaxline entry point to execute training or evaluation with a given experiment class
run_main_train_eval_multithreaded: run Jaxline main in train_eval_multithreaded mode to execute training and evaluation concurrently
review_tensorboard_logger: review the TensorBoardLogger class that writes scalars and images to TensorBoard during experiments
